custom.sample_rate_hz.description: ADC sampling rate fixed at build time; it does not follow the demo waveform frequency

custom.model_accuracy_pct.description: rolling accuracy of the on-device classifier; it reads low right after a boot while the window refills

custom.infer_p50_us.description: inference latency, median of the recent window

custom.infer_p99_us.description: inference latency, 99th percentile of the recent window

custom.arena_used_bytes.description: tensor arena the interpreter actually uses

custom.uart_tx_retries.description: UART writes that needed a retry after the driver fix
